title: Robotic Surgery Reached 3.153 Million Procedures
closing: Robot assistance is becoming ordinary surgery, so patients increasingly need to understand its role.
question: Would you choose robotic surgery?

segments.say: Robotic surgery reached 3.153 million procedures. A once-rare tool is becoming routine operating-room equipment.
Robots handled 15.1 percent of general surgeries. The technology moved well beyond experimental use.
Robotic surgery revenue reached 7.1 billion dollars. Hospitals are building an industry around the machines.
